verdict.rationale: Vestd's help docs say an option holder submits an exercise request through the platform, and a company admin then reviews and processes it, confirming valuation and tax/legal considerations. Separately, shares can be issued digitally with automatic Companies House updates and 'no paperwork involved', so the request and issuance steps are online. Nothing shows how the employee pays the exercise price, and the docs do not explicitly connect an exercise to the share-issuance flow. Missing for 10: online payment of the exercise price, an explicit end-to-end link from exercise to share issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
